bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/lib.rs (audio client), springboard/audiod/src/main.rs, springboard/src/media/audioplayer.rs, springboard/src/media/mixer.rs, springboard/src/media/volume.rs, springboard/src/media/route.rs, springboard/src/media/speaker.rs, springboard/apps/daw/src/devices/mod.rs
summary: PHASE is a spatial and game audio engine: 3D sources and listener, occlusion, reverb, distance models, sound event graphs and runtime parameters. BifrOSt has a playback and capture service with volume and output routing, but no positional audio, no scene model and no event graph API for apps. The SDK exposes only the playback client.

features.bifrost: springboard/audiod/src/main.rs (one process owns speaker and mic); springboard/sdk/src/lib.rs:87 (audio::Client)
features.note: a shared playback service exists; no engine object, no asset registry and no update-mode control
files play through the player and the DAW sampler voices; the sampler is app-internal, not an SDK API; no loop mode options in the SDK
the decoder pipeline streams internally; apps cannot supply their own buffers or set buffer priority
no 3D position or orientation for sound; route.rs only switches outputs

Wave 3 (w3-phase, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. volume is set per route and per player only (springboard/src/media/volume.rs)
mixer.rs drives the card's controls, not a signal graph; buses exist only inside the DAW app

features.feature: Sound event nodes (switch, random, blend, container)
features.apple: PHASESoundEventNodeDefinition, PHASESwitchNodeDefinition, PHASERandomNodeDefinition, PHASEBlendNodeDefinition, PHASEContainerNodeDefinition, PHASESoundEvent
features.note: Wave 3 (theme-09, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. playback is a flat track queue (springboard/src/media/queue.rs); no event tree

features.apple: PHASEMetaParameter, PHASENumberMetaParameter, PHASEStringMetaParameter, PHASEMappedMetaParameterDefinition, PHASEEnvelope, PHASEEnvelopeSegment, PHASECurveType
features.note: Wave 3 (w3-phase, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. no API to change in-flight audio parameters over time
the sound server mixes streams; apps cannot share parameters or duck competing sounds
a per-route volume and headphone cap exist; no per-asset loudness normalization

features.feature: Head tracking and personalized spatial audio
features.note: depends on Apple headphone motion and personal HRTF data, which BifrOSt does not have

gaps: No 3D sound: no source position, listener or orientation, and no spatialization or HRTF output
No occlusion, geometry or material acoustics
No reverb or environmental effects API
No sound event graph (switch, random, blend, container nodes) for apps
No runtime metaparameters or envelopes for changing audio over time
No groups or ducking across apps
SDK exposes only the playback client (springboard/sdk/src/lib.rs:87); the sampler and buses live inside the DAW app and are not reusable
